```yaml
name: Cleanup Preview Database

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  cleanup-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Delete Neon Branch
        env:
          NEON_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}
          NEON_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID }}
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
          
          echo "Deleting Neon branch: $BRANCH_NAME"
          
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X DELETE \
            "https://api.neon.tech/v2/projects/$NEON_PROJECT_ID/branches/$BRANCH_NAME" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEON_API_KEY")
          
          STATUS_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X DELETE \
            "https://api.neon.tech/v2/projects/$NEON_PROJECT_ID/branches/$BRANCH_NAME" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEON_API_KEY")
          
          if [ "$STATUS_CODE" -eq 200 ] || [ "$STATUS_CODE" -eq 404 ]; then
            echo "Branch cleanup successful (or branch already deleted)."
          else
            echo "Failed to delete branch. Status code: $STATUS_CODE"
            echo "Response: $RESPONSE"
            exit 1
          fi
```
